name: cmlmerchant
description: Generates YML/XML product feeds for Google Merchant, Yandex and VK from a Commerce product catalog taxonomy, writing static files served at fixed feed URLs.
version_note: Installed on disk at 2.0.4 but fails to enable in this environment: cmlmerchant.info.yml declares required dependencies 'drupal:catalog' and 'drupal:cmlstarter', and neither the catalog nor the cmlstarter project is present under web/modules/contrib. (The feed service src/Service/YmlService.php also hard-references commerce_product entity classes, which are likewise absent.) Drupal refuses to enable a module whose declared dependencies are missing.
